prompt: A tar rooftop above a Prohibition-era city, the moment after a burst of gunfire has riddled a wooden water tank. Shot from low down on a 28mm lens, close enough that a broken-nosed, clean-shaven man of about sixty-five, heavy brow, black overcoat and wide hat, looms large in the lower right, looking straight past the lens with his chin level. He holds a drum-fed Thompson in his far hand, pointed at the sky. Behind him a dozen jets of water arc from the tank's holes under a steel sign frame seen from the back, its bulb clusters blazing orange. A violet argon tube on the next building lights his face and mouth. The flooded roof at his feet reflects violet and orange ripples, and a far-off skyline of warm points runs along the horizon. Thanks.
